name: scaffold a lake project and pull a math library dependency
definition: create a project directory with a manifest declaring a compatible stable math library and resolve it
failure_mode: unresolved dependencies or bad manifest make build fail

name: write an executable build script that emits a zstd-compressed gnu tar
definition: Produce a shell script that packages a source tree into a release archive reproducible bit-for-bit across runs with equal inputs.
failure_mode: Non-executable script or reuse of stale output fails reproducibility checks.

name: apply the fix in source rather than runtime configuration
definition: Ensure the vulnerability is addressed by a code change and not by external settings or environment overrides.
failure_mode: Only config-level workaround means built jars remain vulnerable and the test fails.

name: compute a dominant eigenvalue and eigenvector numerically in numpy
definition: implement a function returning a dominant eigenvalue and its eigenvector valid for real square matrices
failure_mode: numerically wrong or unstable answers break the eigen-equation check
